# Version Set

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VersionSet`](gmeow-VersionSet.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VersionSet>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

A first-class information object representing a version family or release lineage — the set of all concrete artifacts that are versions of a common stable entity. A [`VersionSet`](gmeow-VersionSet.md) is an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) (a kind of [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)) so it can carry identifiers, provenance, and authority links. Examples: the lineage of a software project, the edition chain of a book, the variant family of an email thread, the DOI concept record.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VersionSet`](gmeow-VersionSet.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
